items.title: In Memoriam: Peter G. Neumann
items.summary:
One of the great applied computer scientists, Peter G. Neumann, died on
May 17. There have already been obits 
published,
including in the New York Times.
I knew Peter since at least 1992, and I’m honored that he considered me one
